plain: Something the network has learned to notice in its input, stored as a direction in its internal numbers.
eli5: One thing the robot's brain has learned to spot, like "this is a cat" or "this is French".
technical: A property of the input that a model represents internally, taken in current work to be a direction in a layer's activation space (not a single neuron); sparse autoencoders try to recover features as dictionary elements.
